strengths: Clear separation of pages and layout following Next.js App Router conventions.
Proper use of server components and Next.js Link for client‑side navigation.
TypeScript usage with explicit props typing for the root layout.
improvements: Add semantic <header> or <nav> around the navigation links for better accessibility.
Include a <title> element or use the `metadata` object to set the page title dynamically.
Consider adding basic styling or className props to the <main> elements for consistency across pages.
